name: timo
description: A local-first routine and time tracker.
author: Timo contributors

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n WEB,DESKTOP -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:web" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && electron apps/desktop/main.cjs"
scripts.publish:api: dotnet publish src/Timo.Api/Timo.Api.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -o artifacts/api
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run publish:api && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.test: dotnet test tests/Timo.Api.Tests/Timo.Api.Tests.csproj && npm --workspace apps/web run test
